The stops in between: Hustopeče, near Hodonice, near Wilhelmsburg and Perchtoldsdorf. near Sopron is the high point. sections.advice: Food stop near Hodonice → Photo stop near Wilhelmsburg rides best with patience. Coastal roads change character with wind and visitors; keep overtakes boring and take the photo from a proper stop.
Photo stop near Wilhelmsburg → Perchtoldsdorf can flow quickly, but only if you keep village limits and junction sightlines sacred. Fast connectors are where rides get untidy when fatigue creeps in.

Use Scenic stretch in Bad Sauerbrunn → High point near Sopron as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.
